verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical 320x50 banners: the italic quote is about 7px and barely readable, the SOLSTICE wordmark/sun logo is effectively lost, the can shrinks to an unreadable orange sliver on the far right, and the yellow attribution is jammed under the quote mark, so the attribution gets more weight than the quote it credits. A also leaves a stray dot artifact (a collapsed logo/sun) under the quote, and its quote sits further left and is slightly smaller. B's quote is a little larger and cleaner with no artifact, so B is marginally less bad.
